_comment: Declared divergences between the tool-execution paths.
A contract a path does not honour must be listed here WITH A REASON, and
the gate fails if a listed divergence has gone away - a stale entry would
hide the next real one. Key is "<contract>/<path>".

exempt.fresh-read-executes-twice/deferred: The second identical call in the same turn never reaches execution: the first one staged the tool for admission, so StagedToolMessage answers the second with the staged-but-not-published notice before the deferred path is consulted. The tool's dedup declaration IS honoured (SkipDedup is sent); what differs is that admission intercepts first. Accepted because the notice is true - the tool is about to become natively callable - and the model gets a real result on its next step.
exempt.unset-approval-policy-agrees/all: The two paths read an unset policy differently, each deliberately. sdkadapter.NeedsApprovalLayer treats empty as 'this caller opted out of the approval layer', so the admitted path runs; decideDeferredApproval defaults empty to write-only and fails CLOSED. Not reachable in a shipped session - applySessionApprovalPolicy and inheritApprovalLocked both always seed a non-empty policy - so this is recorded rather than resolved: picking a winner means overturning one of two deliberate security decisions, which belongs in its own change.
